title: Port the agent to another framework
checkpoint: Students understand which parts belong to the application and which belong to the SDK.

frameworkOwned.original: OpenAI Agents SDK 0.21.0: tool parameters, RunContext, Runner, interruptions and RunState approve/reject.
frameworkOwned.port: AI SDK 7.0.173: tool inputSchema, immutable host context closure, generateText, toolApproval policy, approval-request/response messages and responseMessages.
frameworkOwned.provider: @ai-sdk/openai 4.0.118 for optional local provider execution. The configured model remains unchanged.

preserved: 11 existing schema, domain, repository and deterministic test files remain byte-identical. Instruction text was extracted unchanged into one shared application module.

acceptanceEvidence.storage: Production repository with disposable sequential PGlite; generated IDs and timestamps normalized only for business-effect comparison.

nativeDifferences.identityFields: For all four extra identity fields, OpenAI emits one interruption that host preview rejects; AI SDK rejects the input before emitting an approval request. No repository mutation executes.
nativeDifferences.wrongShape: An array-shaped create input pauses before host rejection in OpenAI; AI SDK rejects it before approval. No stored effect.
nativeDifferences.unknownTool: OpenAI raises ModelBehaviorError. AI SDK returns a tool error and consumes the scripted final continuation. Both execute zero repository mutations.

sharedOutcomes: read tools require no write approval
readers and foreign-tenant references cannot mutate
stale writes preserve the competing update
duplicate SKU and missing products return safe errors
exact replay adds no second audit or receipt
later tool calls need a new approval
model failure after commit leaves stored evidence
private driver details are not model-visible
scope: Actual SDK control flow with scripted model output; neutral fixture text is not a live-model answer-quality score. The port remains a local demo CLI. Authenticated service adapters, encrypted durable pending storage, deployed database transport and live model behavior need their own integration/evaluation runs.
